user.title: NS API key
user.description: Enter your NS API key (the primary key of your **Ns-App** subscription on [apiportal.ns.nl]({portal_url})).

station.title: Departure station
station.description: Pick the station you want to see departures for. Afterwards you can add the destinations you want to follow from this station.

reauth_confirm.title: NS API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: NS no longer accepts the stored API key. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check that you copied the key of the Ns-App subscription.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the NS API.

init.title: Update interval
init.description: NS allows **{limit} requests per 5 minutes** per API key, shared by every station that uses the key. This station makes **{requests}** requests per update (its departure board plus one per followed destination). At the current interval, all your stations together use about **{usage}** requests per 5 minutes.

error.rate_limit: This interval would go over the NS limit for your API key. Choose a longer interval.

user.title: Follow a destination from {station}
user.description: The sensors show the next train from {station} that gets you to this destination, just like the journey planner on ns.nl. If there is no train anymore today, you get the first one tomorrow.

data_description.destination: The station you want to travel to.
data_description.direct_only: Off: the next train on the fastest route, which may include transfers. On: only trains that go there without transferring.

reconfigure.title: Change destination
reconfigure.description: The sensors show the next train from {station} that gets you to this destination, just like the journey planner on ns.nl. If there is no train anymore today, you get the first one tomorrow.

data_description.destination: The station you want to travel to.
data_description.direct_only: Off: the next train on the fastest route, which may include transfers. On: only trains that go there without transferring.

error.same_station: Pick a station other than the departure station.
error.already_followed: You already follow this destination with these settings.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The station is not loaded. Check the integration for errors and try again.
